method.aggregation: Parse call graph indentation. Sum inclusive matches unless an ancestor already matches that metric. Assert every self count nonnegative and per-thread self sum equals root count. Profile lines are 1-based.
method.scope: Main denominator includes waiting and runnable samples; percentages are not CPU shares. Worker totals span different pooled threads and are not comparable to main percentages. Nested metrics overlap and must not be added.
method.window: Sampling was started before fixture payload hashing and the initial 1 GiB ASCII transfer. The ASCII transfer itself lasted 14.692958541 s, longer than the requested 8 s profile. The profile includes an unquantified initial idle/hash period followed by the beginning of ASCII; it does not cover ANSI or represent a wholly active workload window.

limits: Wall-stack sampling includes sleeping threads, kernel calls and scheduler delay; these are not CPU percentages.
Nested cell preparation/render/blit and observation/screen-signal counts overlap.
poll(timeout=0) does not wait for future readiness, but samples can include syscall work or descheduling.
Socket readv presence is not evidence that IPC is the critical path.
An 8 s profile may cross workload phases; consult result timings before labelling its scope.
One profile is evidence for hypotheses, not proof of causal speedup or a quantified performance ceiling.
The initial fixture hashing phase is outside the throughput stopwatch but inside the sampling window; its duration is not available, so no active-only denominator is claimed.

phase1_reference.comparison_limit: Same repeated ASCII payload family, but different workload byte budgets and initial profile timing/hash work. Compare sampled composition descriptively, not as a normalized CPU or throughput speedup.

findings.claim: Cell projection/diff no longer dominates sampled main-thread work.
findings.evidence: CellSync.prepare is 17/5711 (0.298%); Pane.render 13/5711, blit 8/5711 and Style.eql 2/5711 are nested subsets. Phase1 was 1386/5853 (23.680%).
findings.interpretation: Consistent with effective admission before render/diff. Quantified throughput improvement comes from repeated unprofiled benchmarks, not this ratio.

findings.claim: Foreground process-group probing is the clearest remaining sampled main-thread work candidate.
findings.evidence: tcgetpgrp is 477/5711 (8.352%): 425 samples in the ioctl branch and 52 in the isatty/validation branch. GenericPipeline.handle still calls shellForeground per PTY output completion.
findings.next_step: Isolate a reduction of redundant foreground checks while preserving history attribution, progress expiration, shell/foreground-child transitions and input authority. No gain estimate follows from this profile.

findings.claim: Observation and media still perform substantial sampled work outside the main thread.
findings.evidence: Workers: observePane 3652 inclusive, containing Sample.signal 1810 and Sample.capture 383; media processMedia 1729 containing ingestMediaOutput 1521; canonical ingestPane 358.
findings.next_step: Measure repeat observation/media parsing and its cadence separately. Workers overlap; these counts do not prove that observation is on the throughput critical path.

findings.claim: Timer replacement has observable cancellation/signal activity worth measuring.
findings.evidence: _sigtramp has 704 outermost inclusive samples across workers; 655 occur below Io.Select(time.deadline_timer.TimerEvent) child workers, primarily nanosleep paths. Main scheduleCellPublication has 17/5711 samples; deadline_timer.wait has 5487 inclusive worker samples, mostly waiting.
findings.next_step: Count deadline replacements and timer cancellations before proposing a change. Do not label the wait samples CPU overhead or add them to main percentages.

findings.claim: The main thread is usually sampled waiting; the cause of throughput limits is not established by that fact.
findings.evidence: __ulock_wait2 is 4581/5711 (80.213%); event-queue getLocked is 4593/5711. PTY poll has 2630 worker samples and socket netReadPosix 5229.
findings.next_step: If needed, trace read/ingest submission, worker start and completion to separate scheduling handoff, kernel work and blocked time. This does not establish the Unix socket as the bottleneck.

foreground_probe.purpose: Expire pane progress and label each queued history output event with whether the shell is foreground.
foreground_probe.frequency_limit: Frequency is established structurally as once per nonempty PTY read and once per scheduled observation batch, not measured invocation counts from sample stacks.

screen_heuristic.purpose: After an observation batch with output, and only at parser ground outside synchronized output, capture up to 16 KiB of active screen text and run agent-manifest phrase heuristics. Sample.signal is a semantic agent-state signal, not an operating-system signal.
screen_heuristic.candidate: Measure repeated identical screen samples before considering caching the phrase-detection result keyed by text and manifest identity/revision. Keep new observation timestamps, provider reconciliation and state transitions even when reusing detection.

media_reparse.purpose: Copies child output to the media lane and updates a separate VT/graphics state. A text-only shortcut must preserve cursor, scrolling, escape and graphics protocol semantics.
